cases.prompt: Decompose this approved plan into work items and validate the graph before I review it. Do not create tickets yet. Plan (approved by Priya, tech lead, on 2026-09-20): add CSV export of invoices to the billing app. Acceptance: a finance user clicks Export on the invoices list and gets a CSV with id, customer, amount, and status for the current filter, within 10 s for 50k rows; every export is written to the audit_log table. ADR-14: generate the file server-side through a streaming endpoint; no background jobs in v1. Constraints: Postgres 15, React frontend, one engineer per item, every item mergeable behind the invoice_export feature flag.

The graph has unique ids, no missing blockers, no self-dependencies, and no cycles.
